column1: # The words a source is read with: the words of a translation that one of its defects or conventions turns on, a list per
#   source and purpose. Ours, measured on the corpus; each row says why. Edit a row and run forge build: every product made
#   with a list names this file among its inputs. A list no reader asks for, or a word twice in a list, is refused.
# Columns: source, list, word (as the source prints it; a Strong number where the list is of numbers), reads (what the word
#   is read as, where the list maps; \N otherwise), reason.
#   maxfield-asv added-noun        English nouns a translator adds, which the ASV's laid Strong numbers only support (strong-pairs)
#   berean supplied-conjunction, waw-conjunction, opening-conjunction, subject-part, prefix (reads BHSA's number),
#     prefix-part (a number, read as the table's parsing of it), opening-preposition
#                                  the Berean tables' conjunctions and prepositions before bracketed words (stated-pairs, BSB)
#   clear-bible spa-and, fra-and, hin-and, heb-also, grc-also, spa-before-names
#                                  the words a Clear Bible set's shifted and early records turn on, named by sources/clear-bible.tsv
